description: Bulk-delete selected product records permanently. A product still referenced by an open order or a page block is skipped rather than deleted; each entry of `skipped` carries its reason. With allMatching the call is refused when more than 1000 products match: use start_bulk_delete_products for that.

modelId.description: The product model's id or slug (from list_models)

allMatching.description: Target every record matching filter (ignores ids)

priceMax.description: Major units - filters the stored price field directly

priceMin.description: Major units - filters the stored price field directly

name: bulk_delete_products
title: Bulk delete products
